AnnData and Raw

Source: R/io-values-anndata.R
io-anndata.Rd

Reads and writes the Elements anndata and raw, both version 0.1.0. Both are groups holding one Element per Slot.

Usage

check_x_and_layers_are_2d(adata, call = rlang::caller_env())

write_anndata(store, key, value, dataset_kwargs, path)

write_raw(store, key, value, dataset_kwargs, path)

Arguments

adata

An AnnData.

call

The call reported by errors.

store

An open rhdf5 file or group handle.

key

Name of the Element within store, "/" writes into the root.

value

An AnnData or Raw.

dataset_kwargs

A list of dataset creation options.

path

Path of the Element.

Details

An anndata group has X, obs, var, obsm, varm, obsp, varp, layers, uns and raw. The NA layer (X, ADR 0004) is written to X and never inside layers. obsm, varm, obsp, varp, layers and uns are always written as dict groups, even when empty, as Python does. A missing X is not written, and a group without X reads as NULL. A raw group has X, var and varm, and is read as an AnnData that the raw argument of AnnData() accepts.

X and every layer must have at most 2 dimensions to be written, otherwise anndata_non_2d_error is raised (_check_x_and_layers_are_2d_on_write).
